repos_data.description: MySQL Server, the world's most popular open source database, and MySQL Cluster, a real-time, open source transactional database.
MySQL Shell is a command line scriptable shell for MySQL, with support for logical backups, InnoDB Cluster management and more. It supports SQL, JavaScript and Python.
Facebook's branch of the Oracle MySQL database. This includes MyRocks.

MySQL Workbench is a unified visual tool for database architects, developers, and DBAs. MySQL Workbench provides data modeling, SQL development, and comprehensive administration tools for server configuration, user administration, backup, and much more.

MySQL Connector/Python is implementing the MySQL Client/Server protocol completely in Python. No MySQL libraries are needed, and no compilation is necessary to run this Python DB API v2.0 compliant driver. Documentation & Download: http://dev.mysql.com/doc/connector-python/en
